reviews.text: I have been bringing my cats/dog to GoodVets Roscoe Village for 3 years. The techs and doctors are wonderful, always calm and caring. They explain things thoroughly and provide options for treatment. I trust the work that they do and have always had a positive experience with their care. Unfortunately, vet care is expensive and if you are looking for a "good deal" this may not be the place for you. However, if you want a vet that has good availability, keeps you informed and involved throughout treatment, and genuinely treats you like the only patient in the building, I highly recommend the staff at GoodVets Roscoe Village.
Hi, Raquel. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for trusting us with your pet!
Our Dr was knowledgeable, provided diagnoses , options and had a full transparent conversation that we appreciated Litsy is a great cat and we had a really good experience here.

Love this place! My senior Husky/Samoyed mix has been so well taken care of here ❤️ she is 14 and fragile and they are so patient and kind with her and give me honest advice. So thankful my friend Veronica referred me here.
Hi, Andreas. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!

We have been clients of GoodVets for approximately three years. During that time, our cats have been seen by four different veterinarians at this location. For pets with chronic health conditions and lengthy medical histories, that turnover has made continuity of care difficult. Each time we become comfortable with a veterinarian and their familiarity with our cats, we have ultimately had to start over with someone new.

We have stayed largely because of the convenience of the location, parking, and hours. Unfortunately, my experience today confirmed that we will be moving our cats’ care elsewhere.

One of our senior cats takes medication for a chronic condition. This morning, I realized that I had made a mistake and allowed her medication to run out. I called hoping to get the prescription refilled today and fully acknowledged that I should have requested it sooner. I understand that a same-day refill may not always be possible.

What was disappointing was how the situation was handled. The response repeatedly focused on my failure to provide sufficient advance notice rather than helping me understand what, if anything, could be done to get my cat her medication. I ultimately escalated the issue to the operations manager, but unfortunately did not find that interaction any more empathetic or helpful.

The experience also highlighted a larger frustration I have with GoodVets’ prescription process. In my experience, managing ongoing prescriptions here has been very manual: I have had to keep track of when medication is running low and contact the practice to request another prescription. Today I was told that the veterinarian had been booked and therefore had not yet had time to review the refill request. For a household managing chronic medications for senior pets (plus human healthcare - I have two small children I am responsible for as well) I would strongly prefer a practice with a more streamlined prescription-management process, such as refill authorizations where medically appropriate, online refill management, and/or medication reminders.

I recognize that I was responsible for not requesting this particular refill sooner. My decision to leave isn’t based simply on not receiving an immediate refill (in fact, to their credit they called me 30 minutes before closing to let me know it was ready, so thankfully I have my pet’s necessary medication). It is based on the combination of frequent veterinarian turnover, a prescription-management process that has not worked well for us, and how I felt I was treated when I asked for help today.

After approximately three years with GoodVets, we will be establishing care elsewhere.
Everyone was super friendly and accommodating. Thank you for being so sweet to my newly adopted kitty.
Hi, Trevor. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

My experience with GoodVets Roscoe Village was extremely disappointing, particularly in how management handled my concerns. Rather than responding with professionalism, empathy, or a genuine effort to resolve the issue, management was dismissive and provided a wholly inadequate response to a customer seeking support regarding their pet.

Good customer service requires listening carefully, taking concerns seriously, and responding with care and accountability. That was not my experience here. I also did not receive the thoughtful, attentive veterinary guidance I expected from a facility entrusted with an animal’s well-being.

Based on my experience, I cannot recommend GoodVets Roscoe Village. Caring pet owners who expect compassionate customer service and thoughtful veterinary care should strongly consider going elsewhere.
Tango our miniature Schnauzer loves this place. The staff is absolutely amazing I'm so happy that I found this location for his care!
Easy and fast appointment. Loved the service.

My dog had a cough which sounded worrisome.  I was seen the day I called.  The vet tech, Mike, is great with my dog & remembered us.  He shared tips about caring for her which helped me.  I love the place.
It was an awesome experience will definitely recommend them 😉

I have a standard poodle who needs her ears plucked every month or so I typically go to the GoodVets in uptown but unfortunately I was going out of town this weekend and needed them to be plucked before I left I was able to book a sooner appointment through this location, I booked for a ear appointment only but was charged for and examination which wasn’t the problem since I wasn’t at my typical location. The doctor was unable to pluck my dogs ears so he suggested I come back the next day and that I give my dog two separate types of medication before I come back I gave her the gavapenten and other meds he suggested. He told me I would not be charged the next day because he wasn’t able to get her ears cleaned at my first visit. Not only was I charged again but they were still unable to clean my pups ears correctly. I recommend the good pet in Uptown because they plucked my dog’s ears on multiple occasions with no medications and charged appropriately. All together getting my dog’s ears plucked it was about 167$ at this location.

GoodVets is now backed by private equity, and unfortunately, the pricing and decline in service reflect that.

We have been GoodVets members for over five years. In that time, our membership has increased from $65/month to $135/month, while the benefits have noticeably decreased. They are in the process of launching new packages, though it is unclear what meaningful benefit these new packages offer patients. If you are on an older package, I would strongly recommend carefully checking your renewal, because many things that used to be included no longer appear to be.

Their advertised “urgent care” option has also not matched our experience the way it used to. This was originally why we paid for the membership in the first place, because we have a small dog who is prone to accidents. In the past three years, we have not once been able to bring our dog in for a simple urgent issue, such as emergency vomit induction or a check to make sure she wasn’t hurt after falling off the couch. Each time, we were told there was “no room,” and we ended up spending thousands of dollars at MedVet instead.

The final straw was when my husband was told our dog’s pre-surgical blood panel would be covered for the year as part of our wellness plan, since her last one was in June 2025. After the appointment, he was charged $300 at the front desk. He was in a rush to get to work, so he paid and left, assuming GoodVets would be understanding once we explained that we never agreed to pay out of pocket for this service and had been told it was covered under our annual agreement.

Unfortunately, that was not the case. I went in circles with Jasmine, the manager, over the phone and was told that an estimate “would have been shown in the room beforehand,” so nothing could be done. Conveniently, the estimate that she insists was shown to him, has no signature on it. There is absolutely no scenario in which we would have agreed to pay $300 out of pocket for pre-surgery bloodwork yesterday.

The bloodwork was not for an urgent surgery, it was in preparation for a dental cleaning that has been part of our membership for years. At checkout, my husband was informed that while our current annual agreement does not expire until July, the new packages no longer include this and was handed an estimate for $1,600. While I respect that we actually received an estimate this time, it would have been nice to know about the change in packages before we had our dog complete bloodwork for nothing. This entire experience feels extremely dishonest and predatory.

I do want to be clear that over the years, we have loved many of the staff members we’ve encountered — the vets, techs, and front desk team have historically been wonderful. This review is not a reflection of them. It is a reflection of the company’s pricing changes, diminished membership value, lack of urgent care availability, and how this billing issue was handled by current management.

Updating my review Dr Perkins at this location is great. Knowledgeable and compassionate - digs into a problem and gives you her full attention. Tanya and the front desk team are always pleasant and easy to work with.

Their hours have gotten much better the past six months and parking is easy peasy. Their prices are average for the city - it’s not a discount vet if that’s what you’re looking for. The annual wellness program wasn’t a good fit for us with our older retriever with a bad belly, but it might be for others. Our animals are right up there with human family in this house and overall, I feel comfortable they get great care at this location.

We had a visit with Dr. Post that lacked "bedside manner" and left me as the owner, feeling as if the vet gave a list of things wrong with my dog but did not provide me with the path to improvement. This will be the last time I take my dog to this GoodVets location. It's a shame because Dr. Perkins and Dr. de la Sierra are so lovely.

Jasmine the new "Hospital Manager" seems to the the cause of the deterioration of service. it is sad a once amazing Vet Clinic.  The Vets and Vet techs are amazing but the company seems to be doing everything they can to make going here difficult then there are the new receptionists like Maria (very objectionable and difficult to deal with). We have been going here for years and Maria wouldn't even help me connect with the Medical Director to discuss concerns. Jasmine finally called me back and its clear where the deterioration in service stems from.
Amazing friendly staff, and they were great with my cat

My previous experiences with vets have been a mixed bag of stress and overwhelm. Especially with our senior cat who can be aggressive with veterinarian staff. This visit was so amazing, every single person was patient and understanding. You can tell they truly care about making the experience comfortable and welcoming. We will definitely be coming back for any future check ups. Here is my cat Batman chilling after his vaccines—which hasn’t happened this smoothly before !
Everyone at GoodVets is always awesome. From the front desk to the vet herself, they are all so kind, friendly and welcoming. The thoroughness of the vet is unmatched for a Chicagoland vet.

Fantastic staff! All the people we’ve worked with have been really kind and knowledgeable. It was also very clear that they looked at my cats’ charts beforehand, so there wasn’t as many questions about past visits.

My experience with Dr. Perkins exceeded my expectations. Along with her excellent bedside manner, she was able to figure out my kitten's problem and give me a solution for a reasonable price without a bunch of unnecessary back and forth.

Was my first time bringing my good boy Wisky. Jamie on the desk was friendly and helpful to set me up. My husky was dealing with some symptoms of kettle cough.  Needed guidance and certainty from a vet.  Not only were they extremely helpful but genuine and caring with my dog.  Dr. Post and Halle were amazing and explained and helped me understand what was going on and what to do from there. I truly recommend this place just on the care and attentiveness on their part.
I was trying to become a new customer, but no one ever answers the phone.

I scheduled my appointment at 8:45 but in their system it showed 8:30 so by the time I showed up before 8:45 they said I was late. Showed them the proof that my appointment was for 8:45 and they said it was a system error. They were able to fit me in the schedule

We had to get a tire changed nearby yesterday, one of our two buddies has conjunctivitis so we decided to walk over to get it looked at and they were super nice to her. They normally go to North Ave. She's deaf and kinda confused by strangers touching her and they didn't have to pull her in back they were just really patient. They gave us an evaluation of cost before going on to do any work on her to see how we felt about it. We were kind of shocked to see prices before they did anything!!! (In a good way) It's very nice before getting hit by a big bill. I really liked it and we will probably start bringing both dogs here. It's also really clean and cute and welcoming. We feel really tense at the other vet and thought that's just how the vet is supposed to be? Lol. Thank you!!! She was able to sleep good after the eye drops.

(The picture is from home afterwards)

Tbh the best Good Vets location. I come all the way from my neighborhood in Pilsen to Roscoe Village just because I trust the staff and vets better here. They have such a strong relationship with their patients and a good sense of community. I have never seen a vet display cards and letters from pet owners to honor their furry loved ones who have passed. Legit tried to hold back tears reading them all.

It doesn’t bring me pleasure to leave this review, especially because I have had decent experiences with GoodVets; however, the experience I’ve had with them this year was just too bad and traumatizing.

I brought my cat to see Dr. Ford in January or February of this year with complaints of her ear bothering her. He took a blood test and *EMAILED* us with the results, saying she appeared to have large-cell lymphoma. First, I would have appreciated a phone call for such sad & traumatic results. Second, we took our cat to a vet oncologist and spent thousands of dollars in tests and blood work, only to finally get her in to see a vet dermatologist and were told she had a severe ear infection, with a pool of pus in her right ear.

This was 4-5 months AFTER we took her to the vet for ear issues, so I’m confused as to why Dr. Ford didn’t notice she had an ear infection?

Anyways, we continued taking her to the oncologist where we were essentially told that sometimes the labs “overinterpret cytology results” and that she essentially was not displaying any signs of having large-cell lymphoma. This entire year has been devastating, both psychologically and financially, as I thought I was losing my very beloved cat to lymphoma within a matter of months.

Fast forward to this summer, I took our other cat to GoodVets (against my better judgement) because he had trouble pooping. They quoted me $1,000 for treatment, to which I had to tell them I couldn’t afford that, especially after all the vet bills for our other cat that we’ve had over the past 6 months.

This place has not only dumbfounded me with their lack of professionalism and care, but it’s also quite obvious that they want to suck every last penny out of their clients who are just trying to get adequate veterinary care for their pets.

Dr. De La Sierra is nice, but I couldn’t recommend this practice to anyone.

You've found the best, no reason to go anywhere else.  Great, caring and friendly staff.  Excellent vet who took her time with us and made sure we left feeling informed and  reassured plus she did not try to sell us unnecessary tests.  Add to that, the office is lovely and clean, with ample free parking.    We live in the Loop, this is our new go to vet!  Thank you!

Went to Banfield with my cat whom the vet did not see and took my cat to bond vet on an emergency.  The vet diagnosed my cat immediately and was rushed into surgery.  Thank you bond vet for saving my fur baby

My appointment was scheduled for 4pm, and we were waiting in the exam room for almost 30 minutes before the tech came in. We waited another 15 minutes for the vet. This is unacceptable. They said it was because they were understaffed -- which I don't doubt -- but I don't understand why the team did not preemptively give a heads up that they were running so behind and set expectations. Instead, I got a few apologies, a 5-minute visit, and a $100+ bill. Truthfully, I was shocked that they charged me for this visit knowing what the patient experience was like.

All staff were very knowledgeable and friendly! They know how to approach animals with care and patience. They are honest with the estimated cost for care and don’t try to over-sell you on additional diagnostics that you may want to opt-out on. Highly recommend!
Great staff, friendly with me and my pet.
Fabulous, kind, and personalised. Our new vet!
Knowledgeable, thoroughand and friendly, highly recommend

On time, took the time to listen and check up my pup with new separation anxiety, gave me a gameplan for care + needed meds right then and there! Vet tech was also very supportive and took the time to get a detailed history.

We have tried both West loop and Roscoe locations for our cats care.  Both locations are *very* quick to extract teeth at a high price.  Feeling conflicted about pulling a young cats teeth, I got second opinions.
Both vets in the suburbs questioned the ethics of pulling teeth on a 4 year old cat when they just needed a good cleaning and regular brushing.  Not to mention they did the cleaning for 1/3 of the price.  Everyone here is very nice and it IS very clean.  But the vet seemed absolutely exhausted, exasperated and overworked.

Great communication, always good service. Our dog has a lot of anxieties, but she doesn’t mind coming here at all! They do what they can to build and maintain trust, even while doing something uncomfortable like giving a shot.

The Dr and techs were gentle and caring for my 13 yr and  4 yr old.  The younger is very scared of the vet.  They met her on the ground with patience and treats.  Love that the lobby is open and spacious.  Great experience overall.

Dr. Ford was very personable, thorough, knowledgeable, and thoughtful. I very much appreciated his approach to addressing my concerns, and willingness to answer my questions and ease my worries. He suggested a mechanism for monitoring and treating my cat’s diabetes that seems like the best approach for her specific concerns. I’m very grateful.
In and out in 30 minutes! Friendly staff!

The team at Goodvets Roscoe Village were absolutely amazing when I had to take my little boy Buddy to be put down. They made me feel very comfortable with the decision after examining him, and a week or two later I even received a condolences card, with a short message from likely their whole team. It was one of the sweetest things I'd ever seen. If I ever need to take my other cat in for anything, I'll be very confident taking him here.

We had a wonderful experience at GoodVets in Roscoe Village. There was no wait time for our 10 am appointment, the vet was straightforward and explained the best options for the health of our cats in simple terms, and gave us options with pricing. Special shoutout to our vet tech Mike, who was so incredibly wonderful with our babies. We have been struggling with brushing our cats teeth since we brought them home, and Mike gave us some great advice that is working very well. He was so sweet and really seemed to care for our cats (and they could definitely tell he was a great person because they were so comfortable around him!) We will definitely be back for any medical needs for our pets, and would definitely recommend GoodVets in Roscoe Village to anyone in need of a trustworthy veterinarian!

I just brought my cat in for his first visit after needing a last minute appointment and I didn't want to go to the emergency vet clinic to spend lots of money and not even be sure if there was truly an emergency need for my pet to be seen right away. I was trying to see if I could schedule an appointment for my cat sometime within the week at the clinic he was being seen at and gave them a call first. The front desk receptionist at that clinic told me to take my cat to the emergency room right away with not much information. She didn’t really listen to what I was telling her on the phone and jumped straight to you need to take your cat to the emergency hospital. I was luckily able to book an appointment for my cat for two hours later at goodvets. When I got to goodvets everyone was amazing. The front desk, the vet, and the vet tech were all so friendly. I felt very supported in caring for my cat and making sure everything was okay. I also felt the vet had numerous suggestions for what the issue with my cat may be, which showed me that the vet was listening to the concerns I was bringing up. An exam was performed on my cat in a timely manner. The price for the exam and tests was very affordable where I’m sure I would have paid triple for taking him to the emergency room and it would have been unnecessary. I would highly recommend goodvets Roscoe village!
Very professional place! Timing was perfect and doctors were very kind and playful with ellie

I trust Dr. Beauchamp and her team to take care of both Einstein and Pixie.  She's is obviously smart and correctly diagnoses my two senior dogs, but just as importantly we feel like she really cares about them.  I have had nothing but positive experiences with everybody, including the reception desk and vet assistants.
Very thoughtful and compassionate with our Kitty.

more like "bad vets."  DR. MATT couldnt tell  a sick puppy from an aircraft carrier, so much incompetence i cant fit it in a review.  Another post pandemic pop-up business i dont expect to last.  avoid this place, it almost cost my dogs life.

The entire team did such a wonderful job with Ronnie! We're so grateful. She's an extra nervous nugget and everyone was so sweet and caring towards her, which made her feel more safe. I was nervous with her going under anesthesia and really appreciated receiving updates throughout the morning. Thank you so much!!

Have had an excellent experience so far. Scheduling is easy and the front desk staff is friendly and accommodating. I have had no problem getting appointments quickly, and they have been extra helpful as my cats get started with a new medication routine. Dr. Ford has been clear and transparent with his recommendations, and I can tell that my cats health is always his top concern.
Dr. Beauchamp is the best vet we have seen in Chicago. We feel very lucky to have her here. Her staff and her tech (Mia, I think) were excellent as well.

best GoodVets location, staff is friendly and really cares about your pet.

they always follow up (sometimes multiple times) after appointments to see how cat is doing which i think is amazing because my old location never did that

The team at Roscoe Village has been outstanding throughout some very difficult health issues for our cat. The whole team has been warm, compassionate, and thorough with their care and with their attention to our questions/concerns. I have had numerous calls/emails from Drs. Ford and Beauchamp to check in on how our cat is doing post-procedure that feels above and beyond what we have experienced at other vet clinics. 10/10 recommend. Thorough, timely care, patient with our questions, reasonable prices
Patient care was their priority, they made sure my concerns for Mira were addressed and Mira attended to and made comfortable. Great, friendly staff! Patience and communication
They are welcoming, kind, and have options for appointment times.  Being able to have some appointment time date and time options helps with having a senior dog.
We used to take our pet to Banfeild. GoodVets service, availability, professionalism, and quality are light years better. One of the best vets we’ve ever used

Dr. Ford and all of the technicians we've worked with have all been lovely. My dog is blind and requires a lot of patience. I've never felt rushed and feel like they take their time to make sure they're thorough and that he has the least stressful experience possible.
